context: Use a set-preserving seed that includes every accepted published-results path and any documented accepted legacy overlay. Promote by CAS on the protected publication branch. The deploy verifier proves exact artifact/database digests and visible corpus identity. On failure, automatically restore the last-known-good full-site deployment, freeze promotions, and retain the accepted merge as promotion_failed for repair.
description: Enable independently triggered corpus promotions to update the live Results Explorer through the atomic Pages assembler. Preserve site, API docs, and Explorer app artifacts while changing only the corpus-derived artifact. Verify production read model, accepted-path union, live receipt, routes, range reads, and rollback. Only then declare published-results to live reconciliation operational.

anti_patterns.dont: Roll back the corpus by moving the source branch backward
anti_patterns.instead: roll forward the full site to a retained safe artifact above the takedown floor
anti_patterns.why: that can resurrect withdrawn data and rewrite acceptance history

anti_patterns.dont: Target a historical expected bundle count
anti_patterns.instead: compare exact path sets and explicit dispositions
anti_patterns.why: the accepted set can grow and may contain published-only history

preserves.behavior: Corpus promotion changes no package, prose, API docs, or Explorer application artifact unless explicitly included in the manifest.
Rollback never resurrects data below an authorized takedown floor.

prior_art.concept: Preserve published-results as the accepted contribution authority
Reuse transformation semantics in an attested zero-skip publisher bundle

verifications.description: Live read model matches the attested corpus digest and accepted path union
Rollback and forward repair preserve the takedown floor and restore a verified site
